checks.behavior: Clean article. Play it to the end in both apps. In the new app the lit word is the spoken word through the whole text (AC-1). Note where legacy goes wrong.
Tap 5 words in the middle of sentences. The new app plays from each tapped word (AC-2).
New: Previous, Replay, and Next sentence each play from the right sentence, and 0.75× changes the speed. Legacy: the skip buttons do nothing (AC-3).
Article with curly quotes. In the new app the lit word stays on the spoken word after each quote. In legacy the mark can move to a wrong word after a quote (AC-1).
Tap a word right after a curly quote. The new app plays from that word (AC-2).
Article where the audio drops words (the maps need the resync). In the new app the mark goes back to the right word within one word after each gap (AC-1).
Pause, then play. The mark stays on the last word while paused. In a gap between two words no other word lights up.
Open the reading step of the lesson (the orchestrator picks a lesson with a reading step and audio when this one has none). The highlight and the tap to play work as on the article page (AC-4).
